each file only once, thus fixing the issue.

part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: static files inside collections appear in both `Site#static_files` and `Site#documents` (which merges `collection.files`), so `Site#each_site_file` visited the same file twice and `Doctor`'s conflict check flagged it as sharing its own destination.

Applied the upstream fix (jekyll#9141) in `lib/jekyll/site.rb:379`: `each_site_file` now tracks `seen_files` and skips items already yielded.

Verified: `test/test_site.rb` (includes the new FAIL_TO_PASS test), `test/test_doctor_command.rb`, and `test/test_command.rb` all pass.
